experiment: star (hub B reads all, spokes read hub)
rationale: centralized hub binds all spokes through one determination

experiment: complete (each reads the other three)
rationale: fully coupled; no party-line cut survives

experiment: ring (each reads its two neighbours, AND)
rationale: closed cycle of mutual reads, no factorizing cut

experiment: line/chain (A-B-C-D with back-reads)
rationale: connected chain, every interior node mediates two sides

experiment: two independent dyads ({A,B},{C,D})
rationale: factors into two disjoint pairs

experiment: two-hub matrix (B,C hubs; A,D read both)
rationale: matrix org: two mediators jointly bind the workers

experiment: feed-forward star (spokes do not read hub)
rationale: spokes are emit-only sources; the hub is a downstream sink

experiment: hub + isolated node (star on A,B,C; D self-loop)
rationale: triad {A,B,C} binds; D is decoupled and should shed from the core

experiment: bipartite (each side reads the other side's AND)
rationale: complete bipartite coupling, no within-side factorization

experiment: directed cycle (pure copy ring, no AND)
rationale: a permutation/relabelling; each node copied, determination is reducible

experiment: duplicate mediator (S1,S2 both = W&C; parties read S1|S2)
rationale: two mediators carry the same determination; degenerate but still irreducible

experiment: parallel channels (W->C via S1, W->C via S2, independent)
rationale: W feeds two one-way relays to C; no back-coupling, factors W from C

experiment: triple-modular mediator (3 copies, majority vote)
rationale: TMR over the same AND; the vote node S-stack binds W,C, redundantly

experiment: hot standby (S2 acts only when S1 is down)
rationale: primary plus failover; the live mediator still binds the parties

experiment: degenerate parties (W1,W2 identical inputs to S)
rationale: two interchangeable workers; AND keeps each pivotal (each can veto)

experiment: substitutable workers (S = W1 OR W2, either suffices)
rationale: OR makes either worker droppable; neither W is individually pivotal

experiment: redundant copy decoupled (S2 mirrors S1 but nobody reads it)
rationale: core is {W,S1,C}; the unread copy S2 should shed from the major complex

experiment: dual mediators in series (W -> S1 -> S2 -> C and back)
rationale: two mediators chained with feedback; the loop binds all four

experiment: backup that factors (independent {W,S1} and {C,S2} pairs)
rationale: two private worker-mediator pairs, no shared determination

experiment: shared mediator, redundant readout (C reads S twice-over)
rationale: trivial readout redundancy; identical to the canonical triad, a control

experiment: veto (S = W AND NOT C)
rationale: counterpart vetoes; both parties still feed and read the determination

experiment: NAND (S = NOT(W AND C))
rationale: De Morgan dual of AND; same irreducible coupling, inverted output

experiment: NOR (S = NOT(W OR C))
rationale: dual of OR; monotone-inhibitory, verdict should match OR

experiment: implication (S = NOT W OR C)
rationale: asymmetric mixed-sign gate; both parties determine S

experiment: inverting feedback (parties read NOT S)
rationale: AND mediator but parties read its negation; coupling is intact, just inverted

experiment: mutual inhibition (S = NOT W AND NOT C)
rationale: both parties suppress the determination; symmetric, irreducible

experiment: one-sided veto, no back-read (C vetoes, C static)
rationale: C never reads S (emit-only veto source); it should drop out, leaving a dyad

experiment: double negation control (S = NOT NOT (W AND C))
rationale: logically identical to AND; a valence control that must read triadic

experiment: XNOR veto-parity (S = NOT(W XOR C))
rationale: parity agreement gate; known irreducible, anchors the inhibition theme

experiment: asymmetric arity (W reads S&C, C reads S only)
rationale: worker reads more than counterpart; both still bidirectionally coupled

experiment: party with memory (W' = W OR S)
rationale: worker self-loop adds memory; coupling to S persists, stays irreducible

experiment: constant policy node (B always 1; S = W&C&B)
rationale: policy bias B is a constant self-loop; triad {W,S,C} binds, B should shed

experiment: read-only manager (M reads S, feeds nothing)
rationale: M is a read-only sink; core is {W,S,C}, M should drop out (cf. spectator)

experiment: dominated party (S follows W; C marginal: S = W AND (C OR 1))
rationale: C has zero influence on S (C OR 1 == 1); zero pivotality, C drops, leaves a dyad

experiment: policy overrides counterpart (S = W AND (C OR B))
rationale: B can substitute for C when B=1; C is conditionally pivotal, expect triadic core

experiment: one-way manager (M gates S but never reads back)
rationale: M feeds the determination but is a constant source; {W,S,C} core, M sheds

experiment: graded fan-out (W feeds S and C; C feeds only S)
rationale: worker reaches the counterpart both directly and through S; still irreducible

experiment: two managers, both read-only (M1,M2 watch S)
rationale: two read-only observers; core stays {W,S,C}, both managers shed
